changelog: 🌐 Universal AI Floating Translator: Multilingual real-time translator with natural Bengali support, 1-tap translation of complex English code & chat replies, clipboard paste & direct chat send
⚙️ Dedicated PC Power Features in Settings: Added dedicated 'PC Features Suite (20 Tools)' section inside Settings with tool toggles, search, and direct tool launchers
🚀 Prominently Visible '20 Tools' Top Bar Button: Front-and-center labeled badge button on the Chat TopAppBar and floating switcher for instant access
📱 Universal Proportional UI Scaling & Zero Card Overflow: Global 85% density alignment with responsive auto-wrapping so text never overflows outside card bounds
💻 Real Termux CLI Execution: Full terminal integration for Antigravity (171MB), Claude Code (320MB), DeepSeek (450MB), Codex (280MB), and OpenRouter (180MB) with live shell execution
🔄 Dynamic Cross-Agent Model Switcher: Seamlessly switch models between DeepSeek, Antigravity, Claude, Codex, and OpenRouter mid-chat without losing conversation state
🎯 Freely Draggable Floating App Switcher: Fixed center-screen positioning, smooth drag anywhere on screen with edge docking and persistent position
📱 85% Default App Scale: Global UI layout and theme scale automatically defaults to 85% on startup for optimal mobile density
📦 Agent CLI Suite & Keyless Subscriptions: 1-Click downloader for all 5 Agent CLIs (Antigravity, Claude, DeepSeek, Codex, OpenRouter) with direct Google & Web subscription logins without API keys

⚡ 20+ Desktop-Grade PC IDE Super-Features for Mobile: Fuzzy file finder, Git diff manager, multi-tab terminal, MCP tools explorer, slash commands, swarm concurrency HUD, scratchpad, hardware monitor, and more
🛠️ Startup Crash Resolved: Fixed Compose Painter crash on launch and foreground service notification crashes on Android 8+
🎨 100% Unified 'Jin' Branding: Standardized app name to 'Jin' across launcher, system notifications, space manager, and terminal dialogs
🤖 Robot Mascot Everywhere: Consistent monochrome mascot status bar icon and full-color 3D robot mascot across launcher and notifications
🚀 Swarm Multi-Agent Concurrency: Run up to 6 concurrent agents simultaneously (AGY + DeepSeek + Claude + Codex + OpenRouter) without stopping Antigravity
⚡ Ready-Only Model Picker: Chat box only displays active/ready configured models; unconfigured providers show instant '+ Add Key' unlock dialog
🏎️ Supercharged 200-300 MB/s Network Engine: 2MB buffered streams, multi-threaded connection pooling, and optimized I/O pipeline
📱 Global UI Scale Customization: Granular interface zoom from 25% to 200% with quick presets for complete display adaptability
🔄 Automatic Model Quota Failover: Intelligent fallback instantly switches to available models on HTTP 429 quota exhaustion so tasks never halt
⚙️ Hardware Performance Tuning: Safety-constrained CPU thread controls, memory cache sliders, and Turbo/Balanced/Power-Saver profiles
🧩 Dynamic Community Skills & MCP Installer: 1-click GitHub/npm/URL skill & plugin installer with 8 curated developer presets
🖥️ Desktop/PC IDE Super-Features: Quick Open File Palette (Ctrl+P fuzzy search), Scratchpad & Notes, and JIN IDE branding
🔇 Quiet Startup: Suppressed noisy background setup notifications and toasts for a clean, distraction-free experience
🎨 Unified JIN Branding & 3D Robot Mascot: Complete brand identity consistency across launcher icons, adaptive round icons, splash screen, and notifications
